mapper.select: select t.id as tagId, t.tag_info as tagInfo from problem_tag pt left join tag t on t.id = pt.tag_id where pt.problem_id = #{problemId} order by t.id

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.difficulty, p.submit_total, p.pass_total FROM problem p
AND p.difficulty = #{dto.difficulty}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.title}, '%')
AND p.id IN ( SELECT pt.problem_id FROM problem_tag pt JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE t.tag_info = #{dto.tag} )
ORDER BY p.id
